# 295: Complete RightSidebar Decomposition, GSAP Motion Plugin System & Modifier Parity Suite

**Date:** 2026-10-21  
**Status:** Completed  
**Scope:** `apps/studio`, `packages/ir`, `autogenerated-tests/`  

---

## 1. Context & Problem Statement
- `apps/studio/src/components/RightSidebar.tsx` had ballooned into a 3,209-line monolith with over 1,200 lines of hardcoded Accordion panels for 12 different modifiers (`transform`, `relighting`, `camera`, `particles`, `hologram_hud`, `typography`, `color`, `audio`, `procedural_sfx`, etc.).
- There was significant duplication between UI controls in `RightSidebar.tsx` and underlying plugin implementations in `packages/ir/src/plugins/`.
- GSAP timeline lifecycle and easing math were partially coupled to UI components instead of being a first-class citizen of the `ModifierPluginRegistry`.
- `Depth3DPlugin.ts` has been extensively tuned with local Edge AI models and depth cutouts; any direct modification or regression risks breaking AI inference pipelines.

---

## 2. Architecture & Design Decisions

### A. Dedicated `motion/gsap` First-Class Modifier Plugin
- Created `packages/ir/src/plugins/motion/GSAPMotionPlugin.ts` implementing `ModifierPlugin<GSAPMotionPluginParams>` with `targetScope: 'both'` and `targetPhase: 2`.
- Decoupled closed-form deterministic GSAP easing curves into `packages/ir/src/renderer/preview/DeterministicMotionEvaluator.ts` (`evaluateEase`, `evaluateGSAPEasing`, `GSAP_EASING_PRESETS`, `MOTION_LIFECYCLE_PRESETS`), enabling bit-identical parity across SSR and Studio preview.
- Registered in `ModifierPluginRegistry` as `'motion/gsap'` with alias `'animation/gsap'`.

### B. Pristine `Depth3DPlugin` & Dedicated `DepthRelightingAdapterPlugin`
- In accordance with strict user guidance, `Depth3DPlugin.ts` was kept completely untouched and pristine.
- Created `packages/ir/src/plugins/vfx/DepthRelightingAdapterPlugin.ts` (`vfx/depth_relighting`), which adapts flat UI sliders (`lightColor`, `lightX`, `lightY`, `lightZ`, `diffuse`, `shininess`, `rimIntensity`) by unrolling them into `params.relighting: { enabled: true, lightPosition: [...], ... }` before delegating to `Depth3DPlugin`.

### C. Parameter Parity & Schema Expansions
- **`Camera3DPlugin`**: Added `fov`, `focalDistance`, `bokehRadius`, and `roll` to schema and parameter normalization.
- **`CanvasParticleOverlayPlugin`**: Added `particleCount` and nested `shader_group` schema.
- **`CaptionModifierPlugin`**: Added `fontFamily`, `fontSize`, `fontWeight`, `letterSpacing`, `fillColor`, `glowColor`, and `karaoke_group` active-word highlights.
- **`ProceduralSFXModifierPlugin`**: Normalized `synthType || sfxType` and `gain || volume`, and added `sfx_actions` with Web Audio audition and timeline insertion controls.

### D. Complete `RightSidebar.tsx` Decomposition (< 230 Lines)
Decomposed the 3,209-line monolith into dedicated sub-inspectors:
- **`apps/studio/src/components/inspector/modifierCatalog.ts`**: Pure TypeScript catalog, constants (`PARTICLE_PRESET_DEFAULTS`, `MODIFIER_PRESENTATION_CATALOG`), helper functions (`getAvailableModifiersFromRegistry`, `formatTimecode`, `getSectionIdForModifierType`).
- **`apps/studio/src/components/inspector/ParameterControls.tsx`**: Isolated `ParameterSlider` and `ColorPickerRow` UI components.
- **`apps/studio/src/components/inspector/ProjectInspector.tsx`**: Project Canvas Dimensions, 1-Click Aspect Ratio pills, Framerate selector, Duration telemetry.
- **`apps/studio/src/components/inspector/TrackInspector.tsx`**: Track Name, Reorder buttons, Height, Opacity, Mute/Solo, Bus Routing, and Sequences list.
- **`apps/studio/src/components/inspector/SequenceInspector.tsx`**: Timing Card, Relational DAG timing (`after`/`with`/`matchLengthOf`), Blend Mode, Subtitles / Cues table, and Dynamic Accordion Engine.
- **`apps/studio/src/components/RightSidebar.tsx`**: Streamlined to 226 lines as a router and backward-compatible re-exporter.
